book.title: Luka Iesu Keriso Hari Manoḡa Lukaꞌa Mirihiro

content: Ḡozoba zu Kota Vazeḡa Hari Idaidaḡa
Ebu Iesuꞌa ane tahiꞌatahiꞌaꞌa iḡaiḡa kuranoga zu kuru mene modoga veize hari ꞌahoga idane ziro,
“Haba ꞌahogano kota vazeḡa ꞌahoganiꞌa radiunu. Aniꞌe Badiꞌa mene rihoninu zu vaze mene gubazinu.
Eꞌe habaꞌano ḡozoba ꞌahoganiꞌa zuni radiunu. Ani barebare kota vazeḡa vaḡe onamadu uminiro, 'Agire vazeḡaniꞌa eḡe mazao sauꞌa haḡaeꞌohe. Ḡaeꞌa ane haḡai sauꞌa naeḡa hanoꞌi!'
Kota vazeḡaꞌe faḡa hune ḡozoba eꞌe dananoga mene uratiro. Rehano vesuꞌu ani aneꞌa bare ꞌahige rae reiro, 'E Badiꞌa mene rihoneꞌohe zu vaze mene gubazeꞌohe.
Rehano ḡozoba ꞌadi e ufeta ḡunuḡunuheꞌe ꞌahine, e ani umido egadu dananiꞌuma. Mene ꞌougine, ani barebare aradu e fuḡofuḡohiꞌuma!'”
Ebu Zuhiꞌa Boroꞌa bare reiro, “Zaꞌe Kota vazeḡaniꞌa nagini raꞌeteꞌe egoꞌi.
Badiꞌaꞌe aneꞌa ohotiroteꞌe azaḡaniꞌa ohere zu madai uminine, zeḡe umido ziniꞌuma, ebu danazogaꞌe mene sasiꞌuma.
Eḡeꞌa ziꞌohe, Badiꞌaꞌa nagini duduḡa raꞌeteꞌe ḡauḡa ḡarihe ziniꞌuma. Rehano Vaze Ubuganiꞌa bare ariteꞌe madaḡano, Badiꞌa mazao fieꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa nu horoziꞌuma ga mene?”
Farisea Vazeḡa zu Takesi Vazeḡa Hari Idaidaḡa
Iesuꞌa ze zeḡeꞌa bare duduḡa rae raꞌeteꞌe zu vaze ovoe ḡiazeꞌeteꞌe azaḡa mazao hari ꞌahoga idane ziro,
“Mada ꞌahogano vaze aheuꞌa kuranoga radu kuru neḡa itiro. Vaze ꞌahogaꞌe Farisea vazeḡa zu ꞌahogaꞌe takesi vazeḡa.

Farisea vazeḡaꞌe edanadu aneꞌa bare ꞌahige kuraro, 'Badiꞌa, manoḡa tauḡi, mazaḡa eꞌe ḡonore azaḡa, haḡai sauꞌa azaḡa, ubuma ḡezo azaḡa zu ꞌuguḡa azaḡa nunu mene heuḡa, ebu takesi vazeḡa ꞌomo zu mene heuḡa.
Fura tiba zamaḡano e ḡae aheu ogomu moneo zaḡozaḡeꞌohe, zu eḡeꞌa hidiroteꞌe ḡauḡa niduꞌaonoꞌo sinu gaubananao rovonadu sinu tiba ḡauḡa ḡaneꞌohe.'
U takesi vazeḡaꞌe faḡano edanadu adure ḡoha zuni mene ite ehamuꞌenaꞌa ebu ꞌuꞌuga faꞌofaꞌoneꞌenaꞌa ꞌahige kuraro, 'Badiꞌa, eꞌe haḡai sauꞌa vazeḡa. Vetuḡahoꞌi!'

Eḡeꞌa ziꞌohe, Badiꞌa ubumao duduḡa rae radu neḡa bariroteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe mene Farisea vazeḡa, rehano takesi vazeḡa. Iniu aneꞌa bare niḡa mae itine, Badiꞌaꞌa niḡa mae ovoiꞌuma, u iniu aneꞌa bare niḡa mae ovoine, Badiꞌaꞌa niḡa mae itiꞌuma.”
Iesu zu Tahiꞌa Komeꞌakomeꞌa
Mada ꞌahogano vaze nuꞌa eneze guraḡa zuni tutuzadu Iesu vaḡe ariro, mazaḡa Iesuꞌa ꞌevoꞌa zeḡe rana touga uratiro. Rehano ani tahiꞌatahiꞌaꞌa horozadu tutuze ariroteꞌe azaḡa roziro.

ꞌOugirotene, Iesuꞌa tahiꞌa komeꞌakomeꞌa huziro ebu vaze eꞌea ziro, “Tahiꞌa komeꞌakomeꞌa eḡe mazao tuḡuzoꞌi. Ze ago gararoꞌi. Mazaḡa Badiꞌaꞌa zuhiꞌaziꞌeteꞌe azaḡaꞌe tahiꞌa komeꞌakomeꞌa teigeꞌeteꞌe azaḡa.
Eḡeꞌa hube hune ziꞌohe, iniuꞌa tahiꞌa komeꞌa teige Badiꞌaꞌa zuhiꞌaziꞌeteꞌe mene mae ḡihinine, ani Badiꞌaꞌa mene zuhiꞌaniꞌuma.”
Maꞌora Vazeḡa
Iuda azaḡa ibitoziꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa ꞌahoganiꞌa Iesu ḡadiniro, “Ihore vazeḡa manoḡa, e nougine, ḡabone tuḡutuḡu hidiꞌuma?”
Iesuꞌa niro, “Ḡa nougadu eꞌe manoḡa rae raꞌohe? Vazeni ꞌahoga zuni mene hune manoḡa, rehano Badiꞌa ane daꞌo manoḡa.
Ḡa Mose goro ḡoeꞌa edeḡa: 'Ubuma ago ḡezanoꞌi, vaze ago gorunoꞌi, ago ḡonotanoꞌi, vaze moneo ago ḡuriroꞌi ebu viꞌu mogo gubazoꞌi.'”
Aniꞌa naenaeniro, “E komeꞌanonoꞌo ḡoere ꞌahi niduꞌa hegote ariro.”
Iesuꞌa ani ḡoere egadu niro, “Ḡa ḡau ꞌahoga ꞌize mene haḡaeha. Ḡauḡo niduꞌa seronadu zahara azaḡa zenoꞌi. ꞌOugine ḡa adureo ḡau naeḡa boroboro hidiꞌuma. Ebu aradu eḡe hegotoꞌi.”
Aniꞌa Iesu ḡoere igirotene, zamaḡaniꞌa adudaro, mazaḡa aniꞌe ufeta maꞌora vazeḡa.
Ebu Iesuꞌa ani horonadu reiro, “Maꞌora azaḡaꞌe Badiꞌaꞌa zuhiꞌaziꞌeteꞌe azaḡa rougaꞌe riḡa bagaḡa.
Kameroꞌe niduru hoꞌoga diuḡogaꞌe riḡa. Rehano maꞌora vazeḡaꞌe Badiꞌaꞌa zuhiꞌaniꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa rougaꞌe ufeta riḡa.”
Eꞌe igiroteꞌe azaḡaniꞌa ḡadiniro, “ꞌOugine, iniuꞌa ḡabone hidiꞌuma?”
Iesuꞌa naenaeziro, “Vaze aneꞌa bare ḡabone hidogaꞌe mene idaḡa, rehano Badiꞌaꞌe idaḡa.”
Ebu Peteroꞌa niro, “Eme emeḡe ḡau niduꞌa modadu ḡa hegotiro.”
Iesuꞌa ziro, “Eḡeꞌa hube hune ziꞌohe, iniu Badiꞌaꞌa zuhiꞌaziꞌeteꞌe veize neḡa, inuga, negoḡa, viꞌa moga ga tahiꞌaḡa modine,
aniꞌe izidi madaḡano ane naeḡa ḡae ḡehaḡa hidiꞌuma, ebu zama moneo ḡabone tuḡutuḡu hidiꞌuma.”
Iesuꞌa Ane Rune moneo Ḡae Uḡiduḡano Ihoziro
Ebu Iesuꞌa ane tahiꞌa gaubanana aheu fare ani uhiḡano nuꞌozadu ziro, “Eme Ierusalema iteꞌohe. Eꞌea feurine, peroveta azaḡaniꞌa Vaze Ubuga moneo mirihiroteꞌe niduꞌa hudaꞌuma.
Vaze Ubugaꞌe Iuda mene azaḡa ꞌevoreo riꞌinadu zeꞌa ḡirihohaꞌuma, ani mae mazagaroniꞌuma, ani rana soꞌabidiꞌuma,
masiniꞌuma zu maꞌuma. Rehano mada uḡiduḡano aniꞌa bare ḡabode iḡuniꞌuma.”
Rehano Iesu tahiꞌatahiꞌaꞌe ane ḡoere huga mene ederiro, mazaḡa ḡoere huga aꞌe ꞌuꞌuruga ꞌahine, aniꞌa nagini zirotaꞌaꞌe mene ederiro.
Iesuꞌa Ubuma Kuruḡa Vazeḡa Fainiro
Iesuꞌa Ieriko hanitirotene, ubuma kuruḡa vazeḡa ꞌahoganiꞌa ibi genaḡano ehoradu vaze mazao hadi umidinu.
Ani vaze ḡuḡuvaḡaniꞌa harae vitauꞌeteꞌe egadu naginiꞌa fureruꞌeteꞌe ḡadimaro.
Ebu zeḡeꞌa naenaeniro, “Nazareta vazeḡa Iesuꞌa vitauꞌohe.”
Ze ꞌouge nirotene, ani ḡihau huaro, “Davida mariga Iesu, eḡe vetuḡahoꞌi!”
ꞌOugirotene, ibitiroteꞌe azaḡaniꞌa roniro, “Ḡa sifu radoꞌi!” Rehano ani ufeta ḡihau huaro, “Davida mariga, eḡe vetuḡahoꞌ!”
Ebu Iesuꞌa tue edanadu ziro, “Ani tutune aroꞌi.”
Aniꞌa Iesu vaḡe arirotene, Iesuꞌa ḡadiniro, “Ḡa eḡeꞌa ḡae veize nagini haḡaoga urateꞌohe?” Aniꞌa naenaeniro, “Zuhiꞌa Boro, e ehamatihi.”
Iesuꞌa niro, “Ehamanoꞌi. Ḡaeꞌa eḡe mazao fieꞌeteꞌeꞌa manoꞌeha.”
ꞌOugirotene, ani zogone manoradu faine ehamaro, zu Badiꞌa niguneꞌenaꞌa Iesu hegotiro. Vaze niduꞌa eꞌe horonirotene, zeḡe zuni Badiꞌa niguniro.
